subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should this issue be resolved by the broader no-new-config channel repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738, by the default-off group-chat fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096, or by a combined/narrowed variant?
rationale: The issue is a real Teams attachment bug, but the open fix candidates make different product/config tradeoffs around Graph lookups, channel URL correctness, and operator opt-in.

options.title: Land the broader channel repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 or an equivalent patch to cover channel team GUIDs, channel fallback triggering, and thread-reply URL construction before closing the issue.

options.title: Narrow the group-chat opt-in
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 focused on proven group-chat behavior and leave channel-specific root causes to the broader channel fix.

options.title: Combine the approaches
options.body: Fold the channel URL repairs and any desired default-off fallback policy into one PR so docs, config, and closing scope match the shipped behavior.

recommendation.title: Land the broader channel repair
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 or an equivalent patch to cover channel team GUIDs, channel fallback triggering, and thread-reply URL construction before closing the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This is mainly a Teams plugin config/fallback policy choice, and history points to steipete as the strongest current routing owner for plugin-boundary decisions.
